title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 31 October 2026
description: Defence officials weigh an Iron Dome-style interceptor system to protect military bases, a new Logan hospital unit helps delirium and dementia patients transition home more safely, and the Gold Coast council considers appealing a court ruling that overturned approval for a Kirra high-rise. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
